integrity: The packaged verifier rebuilds the deletion set-packing model from definitions, independently checks all six positive witnesses, re-establishes the optimum cardinality, and exhausts all candidate shadow-size profiles in the proved coverage interval.
scientific_limitations: The result is a finite equality-profile classification for quaternary length-four single-deletion codes. Profile exclusions are computer-assisted by mixed-integer branch-and-bound; no count of labeled maxima or symmetry classification is claimed.
title: Deletion-shadow spectrum of optimal quaternary length-four single-deletion codes
